title: sdk/v2.54.0
body:
<!-- generated-release-notes v1 -->

Apps can now declare MCP servers in their manifest using `defineMcpServer` from `twenty-sdk`. Two new helpers — `attachRecordToInboxThread` and `detachRecordFromInboxThread` — let apps and workspace members link records to inbox threads.

Three breaking changes require code updates. `SystemPermissionFlag.CONNECTED_ACCOUNTS` and `APPLICATIONS` are renamed to `USER_APPS` and `WORKSPACE_APPS`. `MarketplaceApp.isVetted` is replaced by `isListed`. `FeatureFlagKey.IS_MESSAGE_CAMPAIGN_ENABLED` is removed; campaigns are now on for all workspaces.

`twenty app pull` now restores `package.json` and `yarn.lock` alongside metadata, and can scaffold a new local project when run outside an existing directory. The `--universal-identifier` flag is removed. A type error in the generated client SDK where `UpdateViewInput.translations` referenced an output type is also fixed.

## ⚠️ Breaking changes

- `FeatureFlagKey.IS_MESSAGE_CAMPAIGN_ENABLED` is removed; campaigns are enabled for every workspace by default, so remove any code-path guards on this key. ([#28929](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28929)) by @neo773
- Workflow builder workflows now export correctly via `twenty app pull`; the manifest format was extended to preserve builder state that prior versions silently dropped. ([#29053](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29053)) by @FelixMalfait
- `MarketplaceApp.isVetted` is removed and replaced with `isListed`; `ApplicationRegistration` and `MarketplaceAppDetail` also drop `isVetted`, so update any code that reads or sets the vetted flag. ([#29187](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29187)) by @martmull
- `SystemPermissionFlag.CONNECTED_ACCOUNTS` is renamed to `USER_APPS` and `SystemPermissionFlag.APPLICATIONS` to `WORKSPACE_APPS`; stored universal identifiers are unchanged, so only the names you type in manifests need updating. ([#29194](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29194)) by @ehconitin
- `twenty app pull` now scaffolds a new local project from your workspace's custom app when run outside an existing directory. The `--universal-identifier` flag is removed. ([#29207](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29207)) by @Weiko

## 🌟 Highlights

- `SystemPermissionFlag.CONNECTED_ACCOUNTS` and `APPLICATIONS` are renamed to `USER_APPS` and `WORKSPACE_APPS` — update every permission declaration in your manifest. ([#29194](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29194))
- `MarketplaceApp.isVetted` is removed; replace it with `isListed` wherever you read or render the marketplace catalog. ([#29187](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29187))
- `FeatureFlagKey.IS_MESSAGE_CAMPAIGN_ENABLED` is gone; campaigns are enabled for all workspaces, so remove any guards on this key. ([#28929](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28929))
- `defineMcpServer` is now exported from `twenty-sdk` — apps can declare an MCP server in their manifest for the first time. ([#29158](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29158))
- `attachRecordToInboxThread` and `detachRecordFromInboxThread` are new exports in `twenty-sdk`, letting apps link any record to an inbox thread. ([#29090](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29090))
- `twenty app pull` now initializes a new local project when run outside an existing directory; the `--universal-identifier` flag is removed. ([#29207](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29207))

## ✨ New features

- `attachRecordToInboxThread(threadId, recordId)` and `detachRecordFromInboxThread(threadId, recordId)` are now exported from `twenty-sdk`, letting apps link records to inbox threads with caller-scoped permissions. ([#29090](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29090)) by @bosiraphael
- `UpdateViewInput` now accepts `translations: [MetadataTranslationOverrideInput!]` on both the GraphQL `updateView` mutation and `PATCH /rest/metadata/views/:id`. ([#29095](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29095)) by @ijreilly
- `defineMcpServer({ universalIdentifier, name, label, url, connectionProvider? })` is now exported from `twenty-sdk` — add it to your app manifest to ship an MCP server alongside your connection provider. ([#29158](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29158)) by @martmull
- `agentChatChannelThreadIds` now accepts a `filter` argument; channel and open-thread summaries return new `mentionsCount` and `needsInputCount` fields. ([#29192](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29192)) by @bosiraphael
- Apps can now receive server webhooks at `/webhooks/server/:appRegistrationId/:functionUniversalIdentifier`, a stable URL apps can construct without a runtime lookup. ([#29204](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29204)) by @charlesBochet
- The metadata API exposes `relatedRecordPaths` and `createRelatedRecordPath` when `IS_RELATED_RECORD_PATHS_ENABLED` is enabled. ([#29243](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29243)) by @charlesBochet

## 🐛 Bug fixes

- Menu item description text in `twenty-ui` now renders in the `Light` color token instead of `Secondary`, matching the Figma spec. ([#29239](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29239)) by @Bonapara
- `UpdateViewInput.translations` in the generated `twenty-client-sdk` types now correctly references `MetadataTranslationOverrideInput` instead of the output-only `MetadataTranslation`. ([#29264](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29264)) by @ehconitin
- The join word in keyboard shortcut sequences (e.g. "G then D") in `twenty-ui` now renders in `Light` instead of `Secondary`. ([#29275](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29275)) by @Bonapara

## 🔧 Developer & API

- The CLI now discovers and bundles React and Twenty UI once from your installed app lockfile rather than re-installing per component preview revision. ([#29018](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29018)) by @Weiko
- `twenty app pull` now fetches and writes `dependencies/package.json` and `dependencies/yarn.lock`, restoring the full dependency snapshot alongside metadata. ([#29197](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29197)) by @Weiko

Notes look like they did before the TipTap migration. Extra padding is gone, and block styles match what BlockNote rendered. Record merging now works on any object, not just Company and Person. The AI chat can merge duplicates directly. Workspace member records have a proper page layout for the first time. A failed spreadsheet import no longer discards your progress — confirmed rows are kept, and invalid ones stay editable.

One upgrade step is required. The @azure/msal-node package moves to 7.x; if your workspace uses Microsoft authentication, verify token refresh after upgrading. The isCustom column is removed from agents, skills, views, and indexes — a migration runs automatically.
